A row is DETECTED BY THE OLD SUITE iff CTL-PLANT recall is not its full attempt count OR any strict-mode false positive occurs in CTL-NULL families (a),(b),(c). It is DETECTED BY THE STRENGTHENED SUITE iff that holds OR CTL-NULL-D's primary arm yields a strict MEMBER at some k >= 1 OR its k = 0 arm is not fully MEMBER. DETECTED means the SUITE'S OUTCOME CHANGES when the component is deleted; it is not a claim that the instrument is correct.
